Hi Michael, Jon Clark here. I’m interested in your 2016 Altima, but I have to be upfront: your asking price of $12,600 sits above even the top end of the KBB private-party range for a car with 83,000 miles. 

Before we talk numbers, I need a complete picture of the mechanical history. Has the vehicle been in any accidents? What major services have been completed, and are there any current issues or upcoming repairs needed—brakes, tires, CVT service, suspension, or anything else? 

Based on the current market data, I’m anchoring my offer at **$10,500**, assuming a clean bill of health and full documentation. If there are defects or deferred maintenance, we’ll need to adjust downward accordingly. Let me know the full history so we can figure out a fair price.
